default/30977.htm.text: Holy Ark: An old, beat-up chest. As you approach you feel its magical power.

Q00348_AnArrogantSearch/30977-01.html.text: Holy Ark: The key fits the lock on the chest perfectly. When the chest is opened, the key begins to glow red-hot and then melts away, burning your hand. In the chest is an odd-looking glass bowl with what appears to be dried blood inside.

Q00348_AnArrogantSearch/30977-02.html.text: Holy Ark: The chest does not contain anything else.
